name: AI Answer Guard
description: **Don't let a convincing AI answer hide a hallucination warning sign, contradict its evidence, or call a failed action 'done'.** AI Answer Guard is a local preflight designed to reduce hallucination, self-contradiction and cascading-error (AI self-collapse) risks: it checks supplied source roots and refutations, compares success claims with tool receipts, flags missing permissions or irreversible-action risks, and returns concrete repair steps. Grounded in Nakagawa Master's interconnected 313 original works on evidence, coherence and correction; theory/source lookup is optional. Not a proven universal cure or an automatic interceptor: the AI host must invoke it with evidence. Free, read-only Python 3 MCP, no account or API key. Install with `qwen extensions install Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive` or [MCPB v1.2.0](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/releases/tag/mcp-router-v1.2.0). [Setup guide](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/AI_ANSWER_GUARD_INSTALL.md).
